messages:
julia m: Hey team  discharged yesterday after a knee arthroscopy at Sunridge (in-network hospital) but got a $4,200 bill from the anesthesiologist who says they are OON. Hospital says anesthesiologist is an independent contractor and I had no choice. I cant pay this. Help?

priya: Sorry that happened, @julia m. This sounds like a "surprise bill" / balance billing situation. Patient protections often apply if the hospital was in-network and you didnt select an OON clinician. Can you upload the itemized bill, any EOB, the consent form, and the facility admission note to the portal or drop them here? Well open a dispute.

julia m: Uploaded the PDF bundle to the claim link (portal -> Claims -> Submit docs). Provider listed: Apex Anesthesia LLC, NPI 1234567890. EOB shows $0 paid for that line. Consent form has a generic line "anesthesia may be provided by contracted providers." I didnt pick the anesthesiologist.

claims-admin: Thanks. Well do two things: 1) submit a formal balance-bill dispute to the carrier citing the No Surprises Act/state rules, 2) send a provider demand letter requesting billing be routed to the facility or accepted at in-network rate. Need hospital billing contact if were to liaise directly.

julia m: Hospital billing email: billing@sunridge-ortho.example and fax 206-555-3322. They already left a voice message threatening collections.

people-ops-bot: Automated note: For surprise-bill disputes, collect: itemized bill, EOB, consent/notice, facility in-network confirmation, and any collection notices. Submit to claims@redwoodbenefits.example with subject "Surprise bill - Julia M - PO-9001". Target carrier response: ~10 business days.

legal-bot: Adding: if carrier fails to resolve, we can initiate Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) under federal/state rules. Also suggest we notify the state insurance commissioner and include copies of all docs. People Ops should not advise paying the balance while dispute is active.

priya: We opened internal ticket PO-9001 and forwarded docs to the carrier today. I also emailed hospital billing asking them to pause collections while we pursue dispute and attached the consent form + EOB.

claims-admin: Drafted provider letter: "Apex Anesthesia LLC  Please withdraw the balance bill and either bill the facility or accept the contracted rate per No Surprises Act. Patient: Julia Martinez. DOS: 2026-10-03. NPI: 1234567890." Faxing now.

julia m: Thank you. If they send a collections letter, what should I do?

priya: Forward any collection notices to this thread and to claims@redwoodbenefits.example. We will flag for legal hold and escalate. We can also request an emergency advance if hospital insists on payment to release records/admit future care.

people-ops-bot: Case log: PO-9001  Surprise billing dispute opened. Actions: submit to carrier, send provider demand letter, notify hospital billing, escalate to IDR if unresolved. Keep originals of bills and any collection communications.

julia m: Im already breathing easier. Appreciate the quick help. :relieved:
